subject: Multi-year credit & escalator structure discussion for ZephyrAI
messages:
From: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@zephyrai.com>
To: jasmine.liu@redwood.com
Cc: Michael O'Neil <m.oneil@zephyrai.com>, procurement@zephyrai.com
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Long-term pricing ask + forecast (3-year options)

Hi Jasmine —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We ran internal numbers and would like to explore a multi-year structure for Redwood across some of our core workloads. Attached is a preliminary usage forecast (Q3'26 → Q4'28) so you can see seasonality and expected ramp.

Two options we're evaluating:
- Option A: Annual prepay (pay up-front for each year) with a term discount applied to each annual prepayment;
- Option B: Single multi-year prepay (pay now for 3 years) with a deeper term discount and an annual true-up.

Our procurement target is to get to something that reduces our unit cost ~12–18% vs list, with predictable escalation and a capped annual growth commitment. Can you give us an initial proposal showing (a) effective unit price under each option, (b) suggested ramp schedule, and (c) any minimums or clauses we should expect on audit/true-up?

Attached: zephyr_forecast_q3_q5.xlsx

Appreciate a quick read — would like to align on a mutual action plan this week so Legal can slot the MSA review next week.

Best,
Sophie Turner
Head of Cloud Platform
ZephyrAI

From: jasmine.liu@redwood.com
To: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@zephyrai.com>
Cc: Michael O'Neil <m.oneil@zephyrai.com>, procurement@zephyrai.com
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Long-term pricing ask + forecast (3-year options)

Sophie —

Thanks for the forecast, that helps a lot. Quick read-through notes and two proposal sketches below. I copied our finance lead for approvals and will loop Legal once we land on structure.

High-level proposals (ballpark numbers, subject to approval):
- Annual prepay (Option A): 12% term discount per prepaid year, with an annual true-up within 60 days. Ramp schedule: Year1 40% commit, Year2 70%, Year3 100% of forecasted usage.
- 3-year single prepay (Option B): 18% one-time term discount if customer prepays entire 36 months. Requires a minimum committed spend equal to 75% of forecasted 3-year consumption to protect economics. Annual true-up with refund/credit mechanics.

Key tradeoffs: Option A preserves cash-flow for Zephyr but reduces discount depth; Option B gives the deepest unit cost but requires stronger commitment and an audit clause.

Next steps I propose:
1) Confirm which option Zephyr prefers (A or B or hybrid split).
2) Approve suggested ramp schedule or share counter.
3) I'll run the numbers with Finance for formal approval and circulate a term sheet + MAA (outline).

Attaching a short outline: draft_tos_escalator_2026-08-30.pdf (pricing sketches + escalator language).

If you want, I can also propose a split-pay hybrid: 50% upfront for Year1+Year2, with Year3 prepaid after Year2 true-up.

Cheers,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive — Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference

From: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
To: jasmine.liu@redwood.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, aditya.rao@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 13:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Long-term pricing ask + forecast (3-year options)

Jasmine —

Thanks for the outline. A few internal constraints to flag before you send anything formal to Zephyr:
- Discount authority: Commercial can approve up to 12% for standard prepay. Anything >12% (e.g., 18%) requires VP approval (Marissa) and Finance sign-off on margin impact.
- Minimum commitment: if we accept a clause that reduces total billed volume below 70% of forecast we need a minimum spend floor in the contract.
- Audit/true-up: include quarterly telemetry share + annual audit right; Legal will want to limit audit scope and tie remediation to credits rather than cash returns.

Please include rough margin impact numbers in the term sheet (expected net revenue vs list) and call out whether the customer wants any carve-outs for burst consumption. I'll review the draft_tos_escalator_2026-08-30.pdf and provide inline notes.

—Vivek
Head of Pricing & GTM Economics
Redwood Inference

From: marissa.cole@redwood.com
To: jasmine.liu@redwood.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
Cc: aditya.rao@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 08:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Long-term pricing ask + forecast (3-year options)

Team —

I reviewed the sketch. I'm prepared to approve an exception to our standard authority for this deal given strategic value, subject to the following gating items: 
1) We can offer up to 18% term discount for a 3-year single prepay, but only if Zephyr signs for a minimum committed spend of $3.2M per year (i.e., 75% of the 3-year forecast) and agrees to an annual true-up within 45 days.
2) Any split-prepay hybrid must include an escrow-style schedule (50% Year1/Year2 upfront, Year3 prepaid after Year2 true-up) and a clear cancellation clawback tied to unconsumed prepaid amounts.
3) Legal must approve redlined MSA; procurement and LegalOps should be looped — cc'ing our sales operations and contracts partner to expedite.
4) Finance wants an explicit escalator cap (no more than +8% p.a. on list) and audit remediation limited to credit issuance.

Once Jasmine confirms Zephyr's preferred structure, get LegalOps the redline request (I reviewed and added comments; see redline_msa_zephyr_v2.docx). If everything aligns, we can issue the term sheet and a DocuSign link for the commitment this week.

—Marissa Cole
VP, Commercial
Redwood Inference

From: jasmine.liu@redwood.com
To: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@zephyrai.com>
Cc: Michael O'Neil <m.oneil@zephyrai.com>, procurement@zephyrai.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com, aditya.rao@redwood.com, contracts@legalops.com
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Long-term pricing ask + forecast (3-year options) — Proposed next steps

Sophie —

Great conversation internally; thanks for the patience. Based on your forecast and our internal approvals, here's an actionable proposal for Zephyr: 

Recommended: 3-year single prepay (Option B)
- Term discount: 18% off list for the 36-month prepay (requires upfront payment).
- Minimum committed spend: $3.2M/year (75% of forecast).
- Annual true-up: within 45 days of year-end (credit/refund mechanics per draft MSA).
- Escalator cap: list price increases capped at +8% p.a.
- Audit: annual telemetry review; remediation limited to credits.

If that feels too large for your cash plan, we also offered a hybrid split (50% upfront Year1+2, Year3 prepaid post-true-up) — same discount tiers but will require escrow/clawback language.

Next steps:
1) Please confirm preferred structure (single prepay vs hybrid) by EOD Thu so Legal can prepare redlines.
2) If single prepay, Procurement to confirm payment timeline and remit PO to procurement@redwood.com.
3) I'll trigger LegalOps with the redline_msa_zephyr_v2.docx and share a DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/abcdef1234567890

I'll attach the final term sheet once you confirm.

Thanks — excited to get Zephyr into production with predictable economics.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive — Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: draft_tos_escalator_2026-08-30.pdf, redline_msa_zephyr_v2.docx
